records.explanation: The warehouse has no credit score or credit rating field for any customer; it only holds invoices, payments, deals, orders, partners and receivables aging.
No table has a salesperson or deal-owner column. stg_deals has only deal, partner, stage, won/lost and dates, so deals can't be attributed to a salesperson.
The warehouse has revenue, invoices, and payments but no cost of goods sold, product cost, or vendor bill data, so gross margin can't be calculated.
The warehouse has no support ticket data. It only covers deals, orders, invoices, payments, partners and receivables, so ticket counts for Acme Corporation can't be answered.
The warehouse only holds invoices already raised, plus orders and deals. It has no billing schedule, subscription or forecast data, so next month's billing can't be derived without guessing.
